name: Restaurant Table and Four Chairs
summary: Neutral square dining table with four independently placeable chairs and blank tabletop accessories.
description: Original 0.8 metre square restaurant table, four simple sand-finish chairs with graphite frames, a small blank table-number stand and a tray with two generic shakers and one plain condiment bottle. Seven placement meshes, three shared materials; no text, logos, brands, textures or external assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / Codex-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python; no external models, images, textures, scripts or brands.
origin: Floor centre of the complete set. Each chair has its own local floor-centre pivot; accessories pivot at tabletop contact.
accuracy_notes: Static visual furniture for a planned restaurant mini-game. Independent chair nodes verified through Three.js transforms; no game logic, colliders or animation are included. Physical devices, WebKit and the assembled mall are unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
